q: Can a laptop refurbisher claim avoided emissions for each device it sells?
title: Refurbished laptops and avoided emissions
short: It can describe them, but separately from its own inventory. Compare a refurbished laptop with the manufacture of a new one, show the method and assumptions, and never subtract the result from Scope 1, 2 or 3. Buyers will ask whether the device really replaced a new purchase.
audience: IT refurbishers and their corporate buyers

ul: Your own emissions reported in full first.
A clear baseline: a new laptop that would otherwise be bought.
Testing, parts and transport counted on the refurbished side.

p: Calling the business carbon negative, or adding avoided emissions to a net figure.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.
